answer: The garden schedule is applied in sonnet and reef exposes each instalment. A payout is split which means 56% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4191 identities would post 4799 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
